title: Strict scalar-cone and Roos comparisons for exact product-preserving functors
statement:
Let A and B be abelian categories, each with countable products and a derived category, and let F:A→B be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. Let S and T be strict scalar-cone completion presentations [def-sfb-strict-completion-restriction-data] on A and B. Suppose F(S.scalar_M)=T.scalar_FM for every M, and that the canonical product comparison of the functor on complexes is an isomorphism for every countable family. Then there exists a Comparison F S T. Its homology comparison is the canonical exact-functor comparison. Its tower maps have the prescribed diagonal cone coordinates; its product maps have the prescribed projections; its Roos maps retain both coordinates and the augmentation; and its localized reduction, completion and unit maps satisfy every representative, transition and augmentation equation of Comparison.

Exact Lean assertion:
theorem strictScalarCompletionFunctorComparison : Nonempty (Comparison F S T)

proof.text:
Map the scalar powers and use the canonical mapping-cone comparison.
The two biproduct projections show naturality and compatibility with the successor
transition. Apply the product comparison followed by the product of the cone maps;
its projections identify the Roos endomorphism 1-T. The shifted-cone comparison is
diagonal in these product coordinates. The zero coordinate and every level of the
augmentation agree. Fully faithful precomposition by derived localization descends
the level and Roos isomorphisms. Naturality and the representative equations then
identify all reduction transitions and units, and the completion unit.
